images.prompt:
## Intended use
Reusable project-library concept for a compact Blood Knight heraldic logo intended for later placement on a novel spine by Publish.

## Scene and background
A single isolated Blood Knight heraldic shield shown straight-on as a finished emblem. The shield carries the same crimson phoenix-like tabard insignia visible on Falanaras's canonical chest: two tall inward-curving flame horns, compact swept side feathers, two symmetrical dark teardrop voids within the lower center, and a sharp pointed lower flourish. The insignia is mounted prominently on the shield rather than printed as loose fabric art.

## Subjects
One shield-shaped Blood Knight badge only, containing one complete centered Blood Knight tabard insignia. No character or additional object.

## Appearance and continuity anchors
A narrow, vertically proportioned Thalassian escutcheon with a subtly peaked top, clipped upper shoulders, gently tapering sides, and one strong bottom point. Thick controlled crimson-red metal rim, thin darker inner keyline, matte near-black charcoal shield field. The insignia is a bold raised crimson enamel or red-metal device with restrained red-gold edge highlights. Preserve the tabard emblem's distinctive symmetry and negative spaces while simplifying tiny feather details for legibility at small spine size.

## Action
Static formal heraldic presentation, perfectly centered and frontal.

## Expression, pose, and gaze
No figure. The shield faces the viewer squarely with no tilt or perspective distortion.

## Setting and environment
Isolated against a uniform deep near-black burgundy background with only a faint grounding halo immediately behind the outer rim.

## Style, medium, and palette
Polished graphic-painted fantasy insignia matching the project's approved visual language: smooth broad color fields, grouped values, clean controlled silhouette and interior lines, selective hard edges, restrained brush texture, poster-like readability. Near-black charcoal, deep burgundy, saturated crimson, and very selective muted red-gold highlights. Clear metal, enamel, and matte field distinctions without dense surface detail.

## Camera and framing
Orthographic front view, close icon framing, entire shield visible with a small even margin on all sides. Tall 3:4 asset composition suitable for reduction to a narrow book-spine mark.

## Composition
One centered vertical shield filling most of the canvas. The crimson insignia fills roughly two-thirds of the inner field while retaining breathing room around its outer flames and lower point. Strong bilateral balance and immediate recognition at thumbnail size. No text landing zone is needed because this is an isolated logo asset.

## Purposeful use of space
Unless the brief explicitly calls for a sparse, minimalist, isolated-study, or open-field composition, concentrate quiet negative space only in explicit text-reservation regions. Everywhere else, make each area contribute to subject, setting, atmosphere, depth, scale, motion, focus, or visual flow without adding clutter. Atmospheric open space is purposeful when it clearly establishes mood or scale; avoid large unmotivated blank areas and do not invent a text landing zone where none was requested.

## Lighting and mood
Restrained low-key studio lighting from above and slightly left, enough to reveal raised rim and emblem depth without dramatic cast shadows. Severe, ceremonial, martial, and morally weighty.

## Reference image roles (actual provider input order)
Provider input image 1: Authoritative Blood Knight insignia, palette, and project rendering reference from Falanaras's canonical appearance. Preserve: The exact overall chest-tabard device: tall paired inward-curving crimson flame horns, swept feather-like side forms, two dark teardrop voids, pointed lower flourish, bilateral symmetry; black, charcoal, crimson and restrained red-gold palette; crisp graphic-painted readability.. Must change: Remove Falanaras and all character, armor, sword, pose, hall, atmospheric, and portrait-composition content. Convert only the tabard insignia into a centered raised heraldic device on an isolated shield.. Image id: a22d39de-1219-4f9b-8475-2aab8132460d.
Provider input image 2: User-supplied shield-enclosure concept and broad silhouette reference. Preserve: The concept of a dark shield field enclosed by a thick crimson rim, compact heraldic presentation, straight-on view, and pointed lower silhouette.. Must change: Replace the low-resolution game rendering, bulky irregular bevels, and its variant emblem with the exact canonical Falanaras tabard insignia; refine the shield into a cleaner narrower Thalassian form and use the project's polished graphic-painted finish.. Image id: 8cfd1c0b-c278-4eb7-b5eb-3374f6962b96.

## Constraints and exclusions
Use the canonical Falanaras image only for the exact chest-tabard insignia, black-and-crimson Blood Knight palette, and controlled graphic-painted finish; do not depict Falanaras, his faceguard, hair, body armor, sword, or background architecture. Use the pasted shield image only for the broad idea of a crimson-rimmed dark escutcheon; replace its pixelated low-resolution rendering, excessive bevel bulk, and emblem deviations with the canonical tabard device and refined small-scale clarity. Keep the emblem complete, centered, symmetrical, and easy to read when reduced. No words, letters, initials, numbers, runes, banners, crown, skull, extra weapons, gems, decorative filigree, scenery, watermark, signature, mock book, spine layout, or typography. No crystalline segmentation, triangular tessellation, crackle texture, or distressed mosaic surface.

## Creative latitude
Meet every stated story, continuity, composition, and output requirement. Freely compose visual details that are not prescribed by the brief or references so the result feels intentional and coherent. Do not infer that unspecified details are forbidden, and do not add literal exclusions such as 'nothing else'.

## Rendered-text policy
Do not render words, letters, numbers, captions, labels, signatures, watermarks, logos, or story copy. Keep all story text as editable Lorekeeper text outside the raster image.

## Output target and protected regions
Raster size: 1104x1472. Aspect ratio: 3:4.

## Intended use
Final full-symbol correction of Falanaras's Blood Knight chest insignia in the successful Hall of Blood concept, based on a positive canonical emblem reference.

## Edit source — provider input image 1
hall-of-blood-portrait-—-moderate-brace-smooth-armor-recovery-pass-1.png (4f0dfb5b-a456-4929-8354-8f24e4c8a656). This is the image to edit.

## Desired edited result
Inside the full-emblem mask, reconstruct Falanaras's complete crimson Blood Knight phoenix insignia to match the attached positive canonical emblem reference. Treat it as one coherent insignia redraw, not as local erasure. Preserve the same scale and central chest placement appropriate to the source figure. Build two mirrored but organically feathered crimson wing halves: tall inward-curving upper blades separated by a vertical dark charcoal opening; outward-spreading side feathers; two distinct round lower forms; a small narrow central lower body; and one pointed lower tip. Most importantly, preserve an uninterrupted dark charcoal gap between the inner middle edges of the left and right wings. The wings must not be joined by any horizontal red line, bridge, bar, crosspiece, band, seam, or stroke. Repaint all masked tunic fabric around and through the emblem so the negative space is deliberate and clean, matching the source's smooth broad value treatment.

## Continuity priorities
The source image is authoritative for Falanaras's pose, body proportions, face, gaze, hair, armor construction, collar, pauldrons, arms, gloves, belt and original gemstone buckle, tabard, legs, smooth surface handling, lighting, scale, and placement. Preserve the belt and buckle exactly; they sit outside the mask and must not be redesigned. Preserve M'uru, chains, dais, architecture, floor, magical channels, atmosphere, and every other scene element. The positive canonical crop is authority for the insignia's exact design logic and separation. The user's diagnostic crop is authority only for identifying the current erroneous red bridge; do not copy that bridge.

## Composition after edit
No composition, pose, framing, silhouette, or armor-layout change. Center the corrected emblem at the same location on the upper torso. Keep the full symbol entirely above the protected belt buckle. Blend the surrounding charcoal fabric smoothly into the unmasked torso.

## Purposeful use of space after edit
Unless the brief explicitly calls for a sparse, minimalist, isolated-study, or open-field composition, concentrate quiet negative space only in explicit text-reservation regions. Everywhere else, make each area contribute to subject, setting, atmosphere, depth, scale, motion, focus, or visual flow without adding clutter. Atmospheric open space is purposeful when it clearly establishes mood or scale; avoid large unmotivated blank areas and do not invent a text landing zone where none was requested.

## Lighting and mood after edit
Match the source's existing low-key red and violet illumination. Render the symbol as matte crimson applique or embossed cloth/plate ornament with restrained edge light. Keep the chest fabric charcoal-black with broad smooth folds and no new texture.

## Reference image roles (actual provider input order)
Provider input image 2: Positive authoritative reference for the proper complete Blood Knight phoenix emblem design. Preserve: Paired separated crimson wings; tall inward-curving upper blades; dark charcoal vertical opening between them; outward side feathers; two separate round lower forms; narrow central lower body; single pointed lower tip; restrained size and matte red material over dark charcoal fabric.. Must change: Adapt the exact design to the source scene's torso angle, scale, folds, red-violet lighting, and painterly finish. Do not copy the reference character's pose, hair, armor, background, or surrounding crop.. Image id: 42c076e7-1320-4bd4-8361-b313d7f15f7e.
Provider input image 3: Diagnostic close crop identifying the erroneous middle bridge in the source emblem. Preserve: Only the source emblem's approximate location, scale, and relationship to the chest fabric.. Must change: Do not copy the red horizontal bridge between the wings. Replace the entire emblem with the proper separated-wing design shown in the positive canonical reference.. Image id: 70ca7e2a-0592-4e9c-84b6-3bee805e8d35.

## Additional constraints and exclusions
Acceptance requirement: the corrected emblem must visibly match the positive canonical crop and must have no red connection crossing between the wings at mid-height. Do not invent a ring, central disk, sun, flower, skull, generic bird, extra crown, extra tail, or additional marks. Do not enlarge or crowd the emblem. Do not modify the belt buckle, collar, hair, shoulders, arms, torso silhouette, or any area outside the mask. Do not introduce scales, diamonds, faceting, crackle, crosshatching, granular detail, glow, magic, text, letters, logo, signature, or watermark.

No text, letters, labels, logos, signatures, watermarks, interface elements, or raster typography. No extra focal hero, creature, throne, battle, or exterior scenery. Keep background magisters anonymous and small. Use the in-game reference only for room architecture, platform function, and channeling action; do not copy its low-poly models, UI framing, overexposure, exact camera, or game textures. No pervasive crackle, facets, triangular patterns, crossing scratches, or crystalline treatment on ordinary materials. Do not duplicate or substantially redesign Falanaras, M'uru, chains, apparatus, or dais.

Do not render words, letters, numbers, captions, labels, signatures, watermarks, logos, or story copy. Keep all story text as editable Lorekeeper text outside the raster image.

Raster size: 1024x1536. Aspect ratio: 2:3.

Render the requested revision as one coherent complete image using the supplied image as its visual starting point. Preserve the explicitly listed identity, story, style, and composition priorities, while allowing nearby pose, framing, lighting, background, texture, and geometry to adapt naturally when needed. Keep unrelated major subjects and story facts recognizable without duplicating, deforming, or partially reconstructing them.

## Intended use
Unattached intermediate visual-development study that preserves M'uru's canonical physical structure while translating it into the project's smooth graphic-painted language for use as a low-frequency identity and style bridge in later Hall of Blood concept art.

## Edit source — provider input image 1
m'uru-neutral-frontal-canonical-candidate-1-1.png (b0aa92d9-7b93-42ce-9c68-8788b0f9aaa2). This is the image to edit.

## Desired edited result
Repaint M'uru as a clean, simplified graphic-painted design while preserving the exact overall canonical silhouette and ordered suspended construction. Consolidate each violet component into one or two broad translucent painted masses with smooth gradients, decisive outer contours, minimal interior division, and selective luminous edge accents. Keep the halo, crown assembly, paired white-gold nodes, central vertical elements, broad outward structures, lower swept pieces, long lower suspended forms, and brilliant central core readable as separate ordered components. Replace all internal rocky texture, tiny facets, fracture lines, chipped edges, granular breakup, and cross-contour marks with uninterrupted violet, lavender, rose-magenta, and indigo color fields. The core should be a smooth white-gold-to-rose bloom with soft atmospheric falloff rather than radiating filaments. Render the dark chamber in the broad, clean, controlled language visible in the supplied Falanaras-and-pylon style crop: large burgundy-black arch masses, sparse red-gold contour accents, restrained texture, and quiet shadows.

## Continuity priorities
The source image is authoritative for M'uru's faceless non-humanoid identity, centered frontal orientation, symmetry, exact major component count and arrangement, component spacing, proportions, upper halo, paired luminous nodes, central core position, outer points, and long lower forms. Preserve its violet-lavender crystalline material identity and white-gold, pale rose, and magenta luminosity. The style crop governs only rendering frequency, edge control, value grouping, and background treatment; do not import Falanaras, armor, anatomy, heraldry, or the green pylon gem.

## Composition after edit
Keep M'uru centered, fully visible, frontal, and vertically dominant with clear dark separation around every outer point. Use a subdued near-black burgundy chamber and broad arch framing. Maintain comfortable margin and uncluttered negative space for design readability. This is an isolated design study, so no captor, apparatus, chains, floor lightning, or action scene is needed.

## Purposeful use of space after edit
Unless the brief explicitly calls for a sparse, minimalist, isolated-study, or open-field composition, concentrate quiet negative space only in explicit text-reservation regions. Everywhere else, make each area contribute to subject, setting, atmosphere, depth, scale, motion, focus, or visual flow without adding clutter. Atmospheric open space is purposeful when it clearly establishes mood or scale; avoid large unmotivated blank areas and do not invent a text landing zone where none was requested.

Solemn, sacred, compassionate, and quietly sorrowful. M'uru is the sole light source, with a controlled white-gold core, rose-magenta bloom, violet translucency, and soft reflected haze. Critical anti-corruption requirement: no tiny polygon facets, triangular tessellation, shattered-glass mapping, internal fracture lattice, rock cracks, crisscross hatching, contour hatching, etched ripples, concentric lines, moire, crackle, pebbling, granular noise, or branching lightning. M'uru remains crystalline through translucent color, angular canonical silhouettes, and a few large planar value changes only. Do not simplify away, merge, duplicate, or rearrange canonical major components. No humanoid body, face, armor, wings, chains, prison hardware, text, signature, logo, or watermark.

## Rendered-text policy
Do not render words, letters, numbers, captions, labels, signatures, watermarks, logos, or story copy. Keep all story text as editable Lorekeeper text outside the raster image.

Raster size: 1024x1536. Aspect ratio: 2:3.

Render the requested revision as one coherent complete image using the supplied image as its visual starting point. Preserve the explicitly listed identity, story, style, and composition priorities, while allowing nearby pose, framing, lighting, background, texture, and geometry to adapt naturally when needed. Keep unrelated major subjects and story facts recognizable without duplicating, deforming, or partially reconstructing them.

## Intended use
Exploratory narrative key-art composition combining the approved Falanaras, M’uru, and Hall of Blood baselines; a wider sample image for later cover-format iterations, not final cover layout or placement.

## Scene and background
Inside the Hall of Blood, the camera looks across the containment dais past the captive M’uru toward Falanaras standing farther back at the far edge of the dais or on the adjoining raised walkway. Falanaras has stopped to gaze at the captive naaru in quiet, morally unsettled awe while its purple-white radiance reaches across the chamber and illuminates him.

## Subjects
Falanaras, the adult male blood elf protagonist in his canonical black-and-crimson Blood Knight armor with no weapon; M’uru, the canonical faceless violet crystalline naaru suspended within the containment apparatus; the Hall of Blood’s circular red-black-gold Thalassian chamber, central dais, radial conduits, pylons, arches, columns, stairs, and elevated walkways.

## Appearance and continuity anchors
Preserve Falanaras’s canonical pale angular face, vivid green eyes, white-blond high ponytail and long front locks, swept ears, compact open crimson faceguard with shortened central point, fitted black armor with restrained crimson edging, moderate pauldrons, dark tabard with large crimson phoenix, red waist gemstone, gauntlets, and layered armor. He carries no sword, scabbard, shield, or other weapon. Preserve M’uru’s canonical complete faceless suspended silhouette, violet crystalline components, white-gold core, rose-magenta and violet radiance. Preserve the Hall of Blood’s established broad circular plan, dark red columns, blackened wine stone, tarnished gold trim, pointed arches, central recessed dais, radial red conduits, fixed extraction pylons, stairs, perimeter platforms, and architectural scale.

## Action
M’uru hovers within the active containment field in the nearer midground. Falanaras stands still farther behind M’uru, hands empty and relaxed, looking inward toward the captive. Restrained crimson containment beams and floor conduits remain active around the dais.

## Expression, pose, and gaze
Falanaras is seen from a readable front-side three-quarter angle even though he is farther back in the scene. His torso and head are turned naturally toward M’uru; his gaze lands directly on the naaru. His shoulders have lowered, his eyes are subtly widened, his jaw softened, and his lips are slightly parted in quiet awe, sorrow, and moral unease rather than theatrical shock. No combat stance.

## Setting and environment
A wider view inside the underground Hall of Blood, showing enough of the central circular floor, enclosing columns, pointed arches, stairs, raised side platforms, radial containment network, and upper chamber structure to understand the architecture. The room remains enclosed, secretive, and oppressive rather than cavernously empty or shrine-like.

## Style, medium, and palette
Polished hand-painted Warcraft fantasy illustration matching the approved canonical studies: layered digital paint, visible broken brushwork and color breakup, varied hard and soft edges, selective crisp detail on Falanaras’s face and heraldry and on M’uru’s core, atmospheric softness through distant architecture, richly modeled but not glossy, photoreal, or 3D-rendered. Deep wine, charcoal, black, dark plum, tarnished gold, and restrained crimson apparatus light contrasted with M’uru’s lavender, violet, rose-magenta, and white-gold radiance.

## Camera and framing
Square wider narrative key art from a moderately elevated eye-level viewpoint set off to one side of the containment dais. Look diagonally across or past M’uru toward Falanaras in the background. Show substantially more architecture than the prior close concept. M’uru occupies the nearer midground without filling the frame; Falanaras is farther back but remains large enough for his face, armor, and expression to read. Avoid extreme foreshortening and avoid a straight side-by-side portrait arrangement.

## Composition
Use strong foreground-to-background depth: architectural framing and part of the containment apparatus in the foreground, M’uru as the luminous nearer-midground subject, and Falanaras beyond it as the emotional subject. The camera-to-M’uru-to-Falanaras relationship must make Falanaras’s viewing direction unmistakable. Offset M’uru from the exact center so Falanaras is not hidden behind it. Use the dais rings, conduits, stairs, arches, and light paths to lead the eye from M’uru to Falanaras and back through the chamber. Architecture should occupy a meaningful majority of the frame and establish room scale. No reserved text region is required for this exploratory sample.

## Purposeful use of space
Unless the brief explicitly calls for a sparse, minimalist, isolated-study, or open-field composition, concentrate quiet negative space only in explicit text-reservation regions. Everywhere else, make each area contribute to subject, setting, atmosphere, depth, scale, motion, focus, or visual flow without adding clutter. Atmospheric open space is purposeful when it clearly establishes mood or scale; avoid large unmotivated blank areas and do not invent a text landing zone where none was requested.

## Lighting and mood
M’uru is the dominant light source, casting visible lavender-white and rose-violet light across the side and front planes of the more distant Falanaras’s face, pale hair, faceguard, phoenix tabard, and armor. Crimson apparatus light remains secondary and lower in intensity. The chamber falls into layered wine-black shadow and warm gold reflections. Mood is numinous, sorrowful, oppressive, beautiful, captive, and morally unsettling.

## Reference image roles (actual provider input order)
Provider input image 1: canonical identity and default Blood Knight armor for Falanaras. Preserve: Pale angular face, vivid green eyes, white-blond high ponytail and front locks, swept ears, compact open crimson faceguard with shortened point, black-crimson armor construction, phoenix heraldry, red waist gem, moderate silhouette, and painterly rendering.. Must change: Remove the sword and all weapon equipment. Replace the neutral frontal portrait pose with an unarmed front-side three-quarter stance in the background, naturally looking toward M’uru with quiet awe under violet-white illumination.. Image id: a22d39de-1219-4f9b-8475-2aab8132460d.
Provider input image 2: canonical identity for M’uru. Preserve: Complete faceless naaru silhouette, suspended symmetrical violet crystalline components, white-gold core, rose-magenta and violet radiance, and painterly sacred presence.. Must change: Place M’uru within the active Hall of Blood containment dais at the established environmental scale, in the nearer midground and offset so Falanaras remains visible beyond it; integrate restrained crimson containment effects.. Image id: b0aa92d9-7b93-42ce-9c68-8788b0f9aaa2.
Provider input image 3: canonical Hall of Blood architecture, containment layout, palette, and scale. Preserve: Broad circular chamber, red-black-gold Thalassian architecture, dark columns, pointed arches, central dais, radial conduits, extraction pylons, stairs, raised walkways, corrected M’uru-to-room scale, oppressive palette, and painterly finish.. Must change: Move from the very wide elevated establishing view to a moderately closer oblique view across the dais. Add unarmed canonical Falanaras farther behind M’uru while retaining substantially more architecture than the prior close concept.. Image id: 2b49ee60-0ab2-419f-a071-1cd7935bd374.

## Constraints and exclusions
Maintain the three approved canonical designs and the Hall’s established scale. Falanaras must be spatially behind M’uru, not in the foreground beside it, and his gaze must clearly terminate on M’uru. Falanaras is unarmed with no weapon or scabbard. Keep M’uru within the corrected environmental scale and do not enlarge it into a chamber-filling monument. Do not turn M’uru humanoid, angelic, winged, or facial. Do not redesign Falanaras’s armor or faceguard. Keep the containment apparatus visible without excessive bloom or beams obscuring either subject. No other focal named characters, combat, readable text, title, logo, signature, watermark, or game interface.

## Creative latitude
Meet every stated story, continuity, composition, and output requirement. Freely compose visual details that are not prescribed by the brief or references so the result feels intentional and coherent. Do not infer that unspecified details are forbidden, and do not add literal exclusions such as 'nothing else'.

## Intended use
A second global style-development pass on the chosen Hall of Blood scene, removing the unsuccessful all-over fractured texture and moving decisively toward a smooth, flat, clean-lined graphic-painted fantasy illustration.

## Edit source — provider input image 1
hall-of-blood-convergence-—-locked-composition-graphic-painted-style-pass-1.png (6d214a94-e84e-41fd-8a5a-eb55e20cc399). This is the image to edit.

## Desired edited result
Repaint the complete source scene in a smoother, flatter graphic-painted style. Remove the pervasive faceted, crisscrossed, tessellated surface treatment from the entire artwork. Replace the many intersecting triangular planes, etched diagonals, crack-like seams, mosaic breakup, crosshatched brush marks, and tiny angular highlights with broad uninterrupted color fields, simple shadow masses, smooth controlled gradients where needed, and clean confident linework. Simplify each material into a few readable value groups. Falanaras's skin should use smooth graphic facial planes with clean features; his armor should read as solid black plate and cloth with simple crimson edging and restrained highlights, not a network of polygonal facets; his coat and tabard should use broad flat folds; the chamber stone and apparatus should use large calm dark shapes with clean red edge accents; haze should be soft and untextured. Simplify his windblown hair substantially into several large ribbon-like pale-blond masses and a few intentional interior separation lines, retaining the high ponytail and forceful leftward sweep but removing the mass of individual strands. Keep M'uru luminous and crystalline in identity, but simplify even M'uru into large smooth translucent violet components with clean outer silhouettes, sparse internal value divisions, and broad white-magenta glow; avoid dense cracked-gem patterning. Actual green gemstones may retain a small number of crisp facets. The finished image should feel flatter, cleaner, calmer, and more designed, with strong silhouette readability and polished graphic painting rather than etched or faceted rendering.

## Continuity priorities
Preserve the chosen scene and its recognizable composition: square low-angle chamber view; Falanaras full-body at lower left, looking up, in the same braced staggered pose with both anatomically connected legs and both boots visibly planted; his compact crimson open faceguard, pale blood-elf identity, green eyes, black-and-crimson Blood Knight costume, phoenix chest emblem, belt gem, high-bound ponytail, two front locks, and strong image-left wind movement; M'uru monumental at center-right with the current corrected faceless naaru component structure, upper halo/crown, paired luminous nodes, central core, side assemblies, separated lower components, violet-white radiance, and integrated containment; the major ring, pylons, green gems, chains, dais, stairs, arches, crimson restraint accents, spatial hierarchy, and sacred-violation mood. Preserve the essential silhouettes and narrative relationships, but allow local contours, folds, highlight placement, architectural surface divisions, haze edges, and minor overlaps to be redrawn so the smoother style works coherently.

## Composition after edit
Keep the existing overall framing, camera angle, figure scale, focal hierarchy, and placement of Falanaras, M'uru, containment ring, main pylons, platform, and chains. Do not restage the scene or adopt the exploration image's close crop. Small local simplifications are welcome: merge minor architectural seams, reduce decorative subdivisions, simplify chain detail, clarify overlaps, and redraw secondary contours. Maintain Falanaras's exact action and weight-bearing stance, both visible feet, upward gaze, and wind direction. Maintain M'uru as integrated into the chamber rather than pasted on top; chains, glow, haze, and depth must pass naturally before and around the naaru.

## Purposeful use of space after edit
Unless the brief explicitly calls for a sparse, minimalist, isolated-study, or open-field composition, concentrate quiet negative space only in explicit text-reservation regions. Everywhere else, make each area contribute to subject, setting, atmosphere, depth, scale, motion, focus, or visual flow without adding clutter. Atmospheric open space is purposeful when it clearly establishes mood or scale; avoid large unmotivated blank areas and do not invent a text landing zone where none was requested.

## Lighting and mood after edit
Solemn, oppressive sacred violation. Retain M'uru as the violet-white and rose-magenta primary light, crimson containment accents as secondary light, and emerald gems as small tertiary notes. Organize illumination into broad flat shadow and light groups, restrained smooth bloom, and a few selective crisp highlights. Keep the image dark and atmospheric but clearly readable, without noisy texture or excessive local contrast.

## Reference image roles (actual provider input order)
Provider input image 2: Primary style guidance for smoother, flatter graphic-painted treatment. Preserve: Clean controlled contours, broad calm color fields, simple readable shadow masses, flatter material rendering, restrained interior texture, clear silhouette hierarchy, polished poster-like fantasy finish, and less detailed grouped hair treatment.. Must change: Do not copy its close crop, enlarged foreground figure, static loose hairstyle, missing faceguard, altered pose, cropped anatomy, simplified or incorrect M'uru structure, alternate architecture, chain layout, scene staging, or object placement. Apply only its smooth graphic economy and clean painted finish to the source composition.. Image id: a00be1c3-2139-4d0c-8010-307f6a1ce329.

## Additional constraints and exclusions
No mask. This is a coherent full-image repaint, not a localized patch. Explicitly eliminate all-over facets, intersecting diagonal texture, crosshatching, crackle, crystalline tessellation, mosaic patterning, etched surface lines, scaly breakup, and busy micro-detail from hair, skin, armor, cloth, floor, pillars, arches, ring, platform, chains, shadows, and atmosphere. Crystalline identity is limited to M'uru and the green gems, and even there use only sparse large divisions with smooth faces. Favor clean curves, long uninterrupted edges, broad flat fills, simple two- or three-step value grouping, and selective line accents. Do not turn the result into glossy 3D, photorealism, impasto, stained glass, a vector logo, or hard cel animation; it should remain a polished painted fantasy illustration with subtle dimensionality. Do not alter Falanaras's anatomy, lose either foot, remove the faceguard, loosen the high ponytail at the scalp, reduce the windblown motion, redesign his armor, add a weapon, simplify M'uru into the wrong anatomy, or paste a frontal M'uru emblem over the scene. No new characters, objects, symbols, text, signature, logo, or watermark.

## Rendered-text policy
Do not render words, letters, numbers, captions, labels, signatures, watermarks, logos, or story copy. Keep all story text as editable Lorekeeper text outside the raster image.

## Output target and protected regions
Raster size: 1024x1024. Aspect ratio: 1:1.

## Edit discipline
Make the requested revision as one coherent image. Preserve the explicitly listed continuity priorities, but do not freeze every unmentioned pixel or secondary detail. Allow nearby pose, framing, lighting, background, texture, and geometry to adapt naturally when needed to integrate the edit. Keep unrelated major subjects and story facts recognizable without duplicating, deforming, or partially reconstructing them.

images.altText: Vertical graphic-painted dark fantasy scene of Falanaras standing in profile beneath the captive violet naaru M'uru in the Hall of Blood, framed by smooth burgundy-black gothic pylons and four broad crimson energy channels.
images.prompt:
## Intended use
Final controlled project-library concept-art retry for the Hall of Blood, restyling the untouched portrait source into a coherent low-frequency graphic-painted image without accumulating artifacts from prior edits.

## Edit source — provider input image 1
hall-of-blood-portrait-—-anti-texture-fel-green-eye-correction-retry-1.png (70459bf7-37bc-41d6-9124-66b8e2a19ee1). This is the image to edit.

## Desired edited result
Repaint the complete untouched source in one coherent pass. Make the result feel created from the outset in the smooth graphic-painted language of the supplied Falanaras-and-pylon crop: broad continuous color fields, flatter grouped values, decisive controlled silhouettes, simplified dimensional modeling, selective hard focal edges, restrained soft brush transitions, and clear poster-like readability. Translate Falanaras's hair into broad wind-swept locks, his black cloth into large uninterrupted folds, and his black-and-crimson plate into substantial smooth armor masses with only essential panel separations. Translate the Hall of Blood into monumental near-black burgundy and indigo columns, arches, pylons, steps, and dais with sparse red-gold trim, quiet shadow fields, and selective emerald accents. Repaint M'uru according to the supplied smooth structural bridge: preserve the ordered faceless violet suspended design while using large translucent components, smooth gradients, minimal interior division, and controlled white-gold/rose bloom. Repaint the source's dense floor lightning as four broad crimson-red energy channels emerging from the dais, curving through the existing floor perspective with continuous ribbon-like cores, soft bloom, restrained secondary offshoots only near their source, and reflected underlight. Simplify the binding chains into clear sweeping arcs with consistent links and controlled crimson highlights. Remove existing high-frequency fracture, crosshatch, ripple, tessellation, and crackle language from every ordinary surface.

## Continuity priorities
The untouched first attachment is authoritative for the portrait framing, camera, perspective, scene arrangement, and story moment. Preserve Falanaras full-body at lower left with the same stance, body lean, shoulder line, head angle, gaze toward M'uru, arm positions, hand positions, leg positions, planted feet, silhouette, scale, and wind-swept hair direction. Preserve his recognizable mature blood-elf facial structure, pointed visible ear, long pale hair, compact vivid fel-green visible eye, stern controlled expression, open red faceguard, phoenix chest emblem, black-and-crimson Blood Knight identity, red-gem belt, long bordered tabard, gloves, guards, and boots. Preserve M'uru at monumental scale on the central vertical axis above the center-right containment dais, with its canonical halo, crown arrangement, paired nodes, brilliant central core, symmetrical outer components, lower suspended forms, and violet-lavender identity. Preserve the main hall architecture, framing columns and arches, containment rings, chains, emerald dais gem, violet windows and flames, monumental scale, and solemn sacred violation. The canonical portrait reference governs Falanaras's stable identity and armor construction; the source governs pose and scene.

## Composition after edit
Keep the exact 2:3 vertical composition and source hierarchy: fully visible Falanaras anchored at lower left; M'uru monumental and centered above the dais; dark framing architecture on both sides; floor depth leading from the lower edge to the containment apparatus. Do not recrop or re-stage. Use large, quiet value masses to separate subjects. Keep the outer architecture smooth and dark, Falanaras crisply readable in black and crimson, M'uru luminous against a subdued burgundy-indigo field, and the four broad floor channels as directional leading lines rather than an all-over network.

## Purposeful use of space after edit
Unless the brief explicitly calls for a sparse, minimalist, isolated-study, or open-field composition, concentrate quiet negative space only in explicit text-reservation regions. Everywhere else, make each area contribute to subject, setting, atmosphere, depth, scale, motion, focus, or visual flow without adding clutter. Atmospheric open space is purposeful when it clearly establishes mood or scale; avoid large unmotivated blank areas and do not invent a text landing zone where none was requested.

## Lighting and mood after edit
Solemn, low-key dark epic fantasy with sacred violation. Controlled violet and white-gold light from M'uru, restrained crimson underlight from the dais and broad floor channels, compact fel-green eye glow, selective rim light on Falanaras, and soft atmospheric falloff. Magical illumination must remain source-driven and directional. Preserve deep shadows without filling them with visible texture.

## Reference image roles (actual provider input order)
Provider input image 2: Canonical identity and armor-construction reference for Falanaras only. Preserve: Mature blood-elf facial identity, long pale hair, pointed ears, vivid compact fel-green eyes, open red faceguard, black-and-crimson Blood Knight armor hierarchy, phoenix chest heraldry, red-gem belt, long bordered tabard, stable material distinctions, and controlled martial bearing.. Must change: Use the untouched source's exact near-profile stance, head angle, gaze, body lean, shoulder position, arms, hands, legs, planted feet, full-body portrait scale, wind-swept hair direction, crimson-violet scene lighting, and Hall of Blood context. Do not copy the frontal portrait stance, sword, square framing, neutral architecture, or its smaller surface texture.. Image id: a22d39de-1219-4f9b-8475-2aab8132460d.
Provider input image 3: Smooth structural and rendering bridge for M'uru. Preserve: Faceless symmetrical suspended identity, halo and crown assembly, paired luminous nodes, ordered upper and lower components, brilliant white-gold rose core, violet-lavender palette, broad translucent masses, smooth gradients, minimal interior division, controlled contours, and absence of dense fracture texture.. Must change: Use the untouched source's monumental captive scale, exact scene placement, containment rings, chains, dais, perspective, and lighting. Preserve the source/canon component arrangement rather than copying the bridge's isolated framing. Do not import its empty neutral chamber or remove the prison apparatus.. Image id: 4f4d74c3-1903-4b2b-b0d8-dbd974e18d2a.
Provider input image 4: Sole dominant visual-style reference for Falanaras, ordinary materials, and Hall architecture. Preserve: Broad grouped color fields, controlled clean contours, simplified dimensional modeling, smooth coherent armor and cloth masses, large hair locks, restrained brush texture, strong silhouettes, quiet near-black burgundy architecture, sparse red-gold trim, selective emerald accent, and poster-like value readability.. Must change: Apply this rendering language to the untouched source's full vertical Hall of Blood composition and exact figure pose. Do not copy the crop, close framing, pose, enlarged armor silhouette, or pylon arrangement. Do not treat any unseen M'uru or energy texture as part of this style reference.. Image id: de39c45e-0ceb-41c6-9a89-4fcede565083.

## Additional constraints and exclusions
Absolute style-integrity rule: ordinary surfaces—skin, hair, cloth, armor, architecture, columns, arches, steps, dais, chains, floor slabs, smoke, haze, and shadows—must not contain crisscross hatching, contour hatching, etched marks, concentric ripples, fractal waves, moire, crackle, pebbling, granular noise, triangular tessellation, shattered-glass mapping, tiny polygon facets, or branching fracture networks. Crystalline treatment is restricted to M'uru and emerald gemstones; even there use only sparse large translucent value planes with smooth transitions, never tiny shards or internal crack lattices. Floor energy consists of exactly four principal broad flowing channels, not a mesh of lightning. Do not let M'uru's angular silhouette influence Falanaras's armor, hair, cloth, anatomy, or the architecture. Do not redesign or shift Falanaras's pose, anatomy, head, hands, feet, or gaze. Do not rearrange, merge, or duplicate M'uru's major canonical components. One Falanaras, one M'uru. No text, letters, signature, logo, or watermark.

## Rendered-text policy
Do not render words, letters, numbers, captions, labels, signatures, watermarks, logos, or story copy. Keep all story text as editable Lorekeeper text outside the raster image.

## Output target and protected regions
Raster size: 1024x1536. Aspect ratio: 2:3.

## Edit discipline
Render the requested revision as one coherent complete image using the supplied image as its visual starting point. Preserve the explicitly listed identity, story, style, and composition priorities, while allowing nearby pose, framing, lighting, background, texture, and geometry to adapt naturally when needed. Keep unrelated major subjects and story facts recognizable without duplicating, deforming, or partially reconstructing them.

images.prompt:
## Intended use
Exploratory narrative key-art concept combining the approved Falanaras, M’uru, and Hall of Blood baselines ahead of later cover-format iterations; free-standing project-library art, not final cover layout.

## Scene and background
Inside the Hall of Blood, Falanaras stands at close range before the captive naaru M’uru. He has just confronted the sacred being held within the crimson containment apparatus and looks on in arrested, reverent awe as its purple-white radiance illuminates him.

## Subjects
Falanaras, the adult male blood elf protagonist in his canonical black-and-crimson Blood Knight armor, without any weapon; M’uru, the canonical faceless violet crystalline naaru suspended within the Hall of Blood containment dais; the Hall of Blood’s red-black-gold Thalassian chamber and nearby extraction apparatus.

## Appearance and continuity anchors
Preserve Falanaras’s canonical identity and armor faithfully: pale angular blood-elf face, vivid green eyes, white-blond high ponytail, long front locks, swept ears, compact open crimson faceguard with the approved shortened central point, fitted black armor with restrained crimson edges, moderate pauldrons, dark tabard with large crimson phoenix, red waist gemstone, gauntlets and layered armor. Remove the sword entirely and do not add a scabbard. Preserve M’uru’s canonical faceless suspended silhouette, violet crystalline components, white-gold core, rose-magenta and violet radiance. Preserve the Hall of Blood’s curved red-black architecture, tarnished-gold trim, pointed arches, dark columns, circular containment dais, radial conduits, and crimson extraction pylons.

## Action
Falanaras stands still several paces from M’uru, hands relaxed and empty at his sides, body turned toward the captive as he absorbs the sight. M’uru hovers within the active containment field; restrained crimson beams and conduits hold it in place.

## Expression, pose, and gaze
Show Falanaras from a front three-quarter angle so both his expression and his gaze toward M’uru are unmistakable. His posture is upright but momentarily unguarded, shoulders lowered, lips slightly parted, eyes widened with quiet awe, sorrow, and moral unease rather than theatrical shock. He looks directly at M’uru. No combat stance.

## Setting and environment
A close section of the underground Hall of Blood around the central containment dais. Curved crimson-black columns, pointed Thalassian arches, gold-edged dark stone, red conduits, and one or two nearby extraction pylons establish the room. Keep distant architecture softened in haze; the framing is intimate rather than a full-room establishing view.

## Style, medium, and palette
Polished hand-painted Warcraft fantasy illustration matching the approved project images: layered digital paint, visible broken brushwork and color breakup, varied hard and soft edges, selective crisp detail on Falanaras’s face, armor heraldry, and M’uru’s core, atmospheric softness elsewhere, richly modeled but not glossy or photoreal. Deep wine, charcoal, black, tarnished gold, and crimson chamber tones are transformed by M’uru’s violet, magenta, lavender, and white-gold illumination.

## Camera and framing
Square narrative key art, close low-to-eye-level camera, Falanaras shown approximately thigh-up in the near foreground from a front three-quarter angle, occupying one side of the composition. M’uru hovers in the near midground on the opposing side, fully identifiable and within the established scale of only a few blood-elf heights. Avoid wide-room distance and avoid extreme perspective distortion.

## Composition
Create an intimate visual exchange between Falanaras and M’uru. Falanaras is the emotional focal point and M’uru the luminous sacred focal point; their gaze/energy line carries the image diagonally. Keep enough of the containment dais, a pylon, and an arch visible to identify the Hall of Blood. Preserve plausible distance and scale between them. Let upper peripheral shadow and atmospheric architecture remain relatively quiet for future flexible cropping, while all other areas contribute to light, depth, containment, or emotional focus.

## Purposeful use of space
Unless the brief explicitly calls for a sparse, minimalist, isolated-study, or open-field composition, concentrate quiet negative space only in explicit text-reservation regions. Everywhere else, make each area contribute to subject, setting, atmosphere, depth, scale, motion, focus, or visual flow without adding clutter. Atmospheric open space is purposeful when it clearly establishes mood or scale; avoid large unmotivated blank areas and do not invent a text landing zone where none was requested.

## Lighting and mood
M’uru is the dominant light source, casting strong lavender, violet, rose, and white-gold illumination across the side and front planes of Falanaras’s face, pale hair, compact faceguard, black armor, crimson edges, phoenix emblem, and empty gauntlets. Crimson apparatus light remains a weaker counterlight from below and behind. Mood is numinous, intimate, morally unsettling, sorrowful, and awe-struck; the Light feels beautiful, captive, and painful.

## Reference image roles (actual provider input order)
Provider input image 1: canonical identity and default Blood Knight armor for Falanaras. Preserve: Falanaras’s face, pale complexion, green eyes, white-blond ponytail and front locks, ears, compact open crimson faceguard with shortened point, black-crimson armor construction, moderate silhouette, phoenix heraldry, red waist gem, and painterly finish.. Must change: Replace the frontal neutral full-body pose with an intimate front three-quarter thigh-up pose looking toward M’uru; remove the sword completely; change the expression to quiet awe and moral unease; replace warm frontal chamber light with strong purple-white illumination from M’uru.. Image id: a22d39de-1219-4f9b-8475-2aab8132460d.
Provider input image 2: canonical identity for M’uru. Preserve: M’uru’s complete faceless naaru silhouette, suspended symmetrical violet crystalline components, white-gold central core, rose-magenta and violet radiance, and sacred painterly presence.. Must change: Place M’uru within the active Hall of Blood containment apparatus at environmental scale, seen from Falanaras’s nearby viewpoint rather than as an isolated frontal portrait; add restrained crimson extraction beams and room lighting integration.. Image id: b0aa92d9-7b93-42ce-9c68-8788b0f9aaa2.
Provider input image 3: canonical Hall of Blood architecture, containment layout, palette, and scale. Preserve: Curved red-black-gold Thalassian architecture, pointed arches, dark columns, central circular dais, radial red conduits, crimson pylons, oppressive chamber palette, and corrected M’uru-to-room scale.. Must change: Move from the wide elevated establishing view to a close intimate eye-level composition near the dais; simplify and soften distant architecture; introduce canonical Falanaras in the foreground and make M’uru’s purple light dominate his illumination.. Image id: 2b49ee60-0ab2-419f-a071-1cd7935bd374.

## Constraints and exclusions
Maintain the canonical identities and established architectural scale. Falanaras has no sword, weapon, shield, scabbard, or combat action. Do not enlarge M’uru into a chamber-filling monument; use camera proximity and illumination to create presence. Do not turn M’uru humanoid, angelic, winged, or facial. Do not redesign Falanaras’s armor or faceguard. Keep the containment system visible but do not bury either focal subject under excessive beams or bloom. No other focal characters. No readable text, title, logo, signature, watermark, or game interface.

## Creative latitude
Meet every stated story, continuity, composition, and output requirement. Freely compose visual details that are not prescribed by the brief or references so the result feels intentional and coherent. Do not infer that unspecified details are forbidden, and do not add literal exclusions such as 'nothing else'.

## Rendered-text policy
Do not render words, letters, numbers, captions, labels, signatures, watermarks, logos, or story copy. Keep all story text as editable Lorekeeper text outside the raster image.

## Output target and protected regions
Raster size: 1024x1024. Aspect ratio: 1:1.

Localized visual-canon correction to Falanaras's eyes in the Hall of Blood concept art.

hall-of-blood-portrait-—-canonical-separated-wing-chest-emblem-retry-1.png (1cc70f62-6080-4d70-b434-59ca8d2bbbb7). This is the image to edit.

Within the small eye-region mask, repaint every portion of Falanaras's eye that is genuinely visible at the existing near-profile angle as a vivid fel-green magical orb. Replace the current muted amber-red eye color with a saturated yellow-green core, richer emerald-green outer glow, and a small controlled highlight. The glow should make the visible eye read unmistakably as the fel-touched eye of a blood elf while remaining anatomically seated inside the existing eyelids.
